title: land records one land.end per landing: a verify step that fails on a fetch and is retried does not log a failed landing
goal: backlog.py land writes land.end with exit 1 only when the landing stops; a verify-step fetch failure that the landing retries and passes logs its land.step row, not a land.end, so ops shows one land.end per landing

run: import sys; s=open('_tools/bl_land.py').read(); i=s.find('ops_mark("verify")'); sys.exit(0 if 'retry' in s[i-1500:i+1500] else 1)

notes: SP-qinvdomv close: ST-5hywunah's landing logged land.step verify exit=1 and land.end exit=1 at 18:18:03 (git fetch: Permission denied (publickey), a transient host failure), then went on and landed; ops reads it as a failed landing.
